## Definition Of Done

- [ ] `make fmt`
- [ ] `make generate`
- [ ] `make lint`

- [ ] OCR editor flow evidence attached: process/import page, edit line or word text, save, reload, and verify the change persists.
- [ ] Export evidence attached when annotations changed: plain text plus hOCR, PAGE XML, or ALTO XML as applicable.
- [ ] Security and operations impact considered: auth, workspace access, Vault secrets, Terraform, logs, and failure behavior.
